description: §5.2 rule 3 (S457 SVG animation values): a `to` / `values` on `<set>` / `<animate>` whose attributeName names a URL attribute is a URL write judged on every write — a non-admitted scheme (any `values` entry) writes about:blank; a safe value is written unchanged; the expression form `to=${…}` is written (no longer dropped); a non-URL attributeName is not judged.
rationale: §5.2 rule 3 (S457): "A write of `to` / `from` / `by` / `values` on an SVG animation element that rule 2 makes a URL-valued attribute … is a covered write, in every form above"; `values` "judges every `;`-separated entry"; "Any other value SHALL be written as `about:blank`". Chromium runs `` on click (g-svg-animation-and-meta-refresh-url-sinks-s456).
